findings: A hash of zero is also the empty-slot sentinel: repeated insertions count as unique.
64-probe limit returns duplicate for a unique explicit hash under moderate table load.
Rehash 64-probe limit silently loses an occupied hash while retaining count.
Final unterminated input line is dropped.
Overlong line resets buffer and emits a suffix, rather than refusing or preserving the record.
Chunk data references are borrowed; deterministic pre-worker mutation changes output. Actual io_uring path resubmits the same buffer immediately after enqueue.
Input chunks can complete out of order and are shared among workers with independent partial-line state. Multiworker line correctness is unqualified.
writev result/partial writes/errors ignored; output opened/truncated even when input open fails.
Same input/output path is not refused; fixed roughly80MB initial hash table plus32x64KiB ring allocations and perworker buffers.
No source mutation snapshot, byte-confirmation after hash match or complete read-error publication guard.
scope: All three pinned source files read and Git blob hashes checked; extracted unchanged functions executed on macOS with explicit controlled hash adapter. No Linux io_uring/O_DIRECT, full CLI, throughput benchmark, actual xxHash collision or concurrent stress qualification.
